output.text: {"notes":["All requested quantities are terminal readouts at absolute time t=1.0 s; joint angles are unwrapped and expressed in radians.","Joint angles and angular velocities use each joint’s local frame; the tip position and arm limit flag use the world frame.","The world frame is right-handed with x forward, y left, and z up; all listed channels use SI units.","A scheduled +0.5 N·m torque pulse is applied to joint_1 on [0.4291, 0.5291) s; the joint-limit flag denotes whether either joint reaches |angle|=2.8 rad by t=1.0 s."]}
